content: MK reports that in the introduction to the Mafahis Ibn Turka explicitly rejects absolute being, the focus of the Tamhid, as an adequate object of inquiry: only the letter encompasses all that is and is not, all that can and cannot be, and is hence the proper object of a universal science.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, K. al-Mafaḥiṣ, MS Majlis 10196 f. 53a ff.
